release_notes:
Fix invisible order-search bar and admin language selector showing wrong language

Search bar (customer order pages)
- The "Search Orders" accordion header was invisible: the modern theme forces
  .card-header { background:#fff !important }, which overrode the inline per-theme
  colour, leaving the white ("text-light") toggle text on a white bar. Restyled the
  #accordion search header coherently — a clean light bar with dark text, an emerald
  magnifier and a state chevron — always readable regardless of the user's ThemeColor.
  Also themed the Search button (slate). Covers IMEI, File and Server order lists and
  the credit-history search (all share #accordion).

Admin language selector
- The top-header language dropdown always showed the US flag / "US" no matter which
  language was selected. The trigger now reflects the current language
  ($_SESSION['LANGUAGE_BE']) via a code -> flag/label map (falls back to English).
